notes.title: 1st Anniversary Patch, version 0.56
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125028/a24693a91726bf051d553fee2f0c76fd2d901205.png"]

To all aspiring kingpings, godmothers and gangbosses,

Today marks the first anniversary of ALL IN THE GAME's early-access launch! After the lead developer's stint as a public servant, development has resumed for the summer. To give everyone a taste of what's to come, here are the patch notes to the recently released version 0.56.1750857988 of our game.

New content 

Added a new building type: Mall. Mall has a base property value of $5,000. It holds 1x Utility, 1x Streetside and 3x Commercial Amenity slots and 2x Activity slots. It provides +3 daily Black Market purchases to its owner. It can be targeted by Store Robbery, Claim Turf, Auto Theft, Pickpocket, Bling Recruitment, Fencing and Controlled Demolition.

 Balance 

Increased the base daily Black Market purchases from 1 to 2,

Rebalanced the Factory Break-In Operation: Reduced Chemicals yield from 8 to 5, Clothes yield from 6 to 4 and Spray Paint yield from 9 to 4. Reduced base risk chance from 30% to 20% and Stealth cost from 30 to 20.

Increased the minimum RP yield from the Recruitment Campaign Assignment by 1

 Quality of life 

Added a radial bar around Turn Agenda circle to better gauge how much time player has used during their turn,

 Bugs and issues 

Some of the bugfixes that were implemented back in 2024 weren't registered to the change log, so I don't remember all of them. Overall, the game should be a bit more stable.

Fixed several minor issues such as typos, misleading information and interface problems

Fixed an issue when loading a save causes a crash caused by turn timer not resetting properly

Fixed an issue that caused some tutorials to crash when initiated

 Graphics 

All Amenities now have a unique icon rather than sharing the same slot icon

Activity draggables now have their respective backdrop in their frame

Made some slight improvements on the Activity icons

Added slightly improved sprites for the Soldier-type Lieutenant

 Miscellaneous 

Set the default timer setting as No Timer

Added a proper Manual entry for the Forgery Assignment
